pageTitle: "Adventurer's Trials" Has Begun, Take Part in the Topic Event to Win Primogems
name: "Adventurer's Trials" Has Begun, Take Part in the Topic Event to Win Primogems
description: Olah! Hello, Travelers~ As adventurers of Teyvat, you have often had to face various challenges and trials! Did you have an exciting experience in the "Adventurer's Trials" event? If you could design the challenge trials, what ideas would you come up with? Come share it all with us! Share your ideas for a chance to win Primogems!
